correctness.rationale: Anchor the unique b at 0 and put the two a's at t<u. All n=h+3 cuts are distinct rotations. An a at v contributes v cuts to ab, a c at w contributes n-w cuts to bc, and an (a,b,c) triple contributes v-w cuts precisely when w<v. Excluding the earlier a from the c-positions for the second a gives Y=(t(t-1)+u(u-1))/2-(u-t) for the sum of abc entries. At fixed s=t+u (recovered from ab), equality of Y is equality of (u-t-2)^2. Distinct positive gaps must then be 1 and 3; putting both in the allowed range gives the disjoint collisions (j,j+1) versus (j-1,j+2), 2≤j≤h. This exhausts the fibers, including no collisions at h=0,1, and yields the image and singleton counts by subtracting one or two per pair. For one a, its position is recovered directly from ab. The uploaded finite oracle was inspected, not executed; it is not needed to justify the quantified proof.
